source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: This model's next Order can go to 1 eligible unit of yours within 12" of it. If that is the first Order any of your units issues in this Command phase, it also affects every other eligible unit of yours within 6" of the unit that received it.

ability.appliesTo: next Order issued by this model

spread.condition: army's first Order this Command phase
spread.of: the unit that received the Order
